rules.title: GATE 2027 — photo
rules.source_title: GATE 2027 (IIT Madras): Photograph and Signature page

excerpts.text: Upload a good quality, color photograph of passport size (3.5 cm width × 4.5 cm height) with the face of the candidate covering 60-70% of the photograph.
Photograph can be in JPEG/JPG format with minimum aspect ratio of 0.66 and maximum aspect ratio of 0.89.
The maximum pixel resolution is 530 x 690 pixels and the minimum resolution is 200 x 260 pixels. The file size must be minimum of 5 kB and a maximum of 600 kB.

derived.aspect: 7:9 is derived from 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm (0.78), inside the allowed 0.66 to 0.89. The app checks one shape, not a range.

notes: The page has no date; 2 Sep 2026 is when GATE 2027 applications opened.
This exam also takes a live photo on its portal. This app cannot do that step.
